vb_textbox.text: Not 100% sure but my advice would be:- consecutively select the gnome with either tall or short hat (colour does not matter) - they may appear on the right or left - then, after selecting the gnome, I believe the points are influenced by the speed with which you press space in the second screen. Experiment a few times to see what works, then stick to it. - when this sequence stops working, change it up
